compass: Real-VIX unified tri-scope conditional scenario generator
hypothesis: The deployable real-VIX tri-scope incumbent 734a/739a should remain protected while the IV-only 755a short-prefix exposure ingredient is tested as a frozen tri-scope framework candidate.
prediction_L3: A promotable candidate must preserve IV mean reversion and risk-manager scenario realism while matching or improving anchor-only and joint panel realism/co-movement. IV-only improvements are diagnostic until the same recipe is run on IV-only, anchor-only, and joint.
kill_gate: Reject deployable promotion if IV mean reversion regresses, IV scenario realism regresses, anchor/joint realism regresses, or the run only works by changing loss weights, backend, sampler, calibration layer, or stochastic source across scopes. Old conditionality is replaced by risk-state allocation when it passes. Old IV-EWMA cointegration is monitoring-only until a formal new gate is defined.
